TI BQ27541 compatible fuel gauge

Required properties:
- compatible: must be "ti,bq27541-battery"
- reg: I2C slave address

Optional properties:
- modify-soc-smooth: allow the driver to program the BQ27411-compatible
  state-of-charge smoothing parameters

Example:

	fuel-gauge@55 {
		compatible = "ti,bq27541-battery";
		reg = <0x55>;
		modify-soc-smooth;
	};
